title: Does Regime-Gated Attention Help Stock Return Prediction? A Leakage-Controlled, Pre-Registered Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2606.29347v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Regime-aware attention is an appealing inductive bias for stock-return prediction, but claims about it are rarely tested under leakage-controlled, out-of-sample conditions. We re-examine the Adaptive Financial Transformer (AFT), which biases self-attention with feature-group similarities weighted by gates that a market-regime encoder produces. First, on a single stock under a corrected protocol (aligned and purged windows, identical test dates for all models, cost-aware non-overlapping backtests, five seeds, Diebold-Mariano tests), no learned model beats the historical-mean forecast. The AFT's regime and context components are numerically inert: the learned gates have 0.9982 of maximal entropy, the context bias has 0.020 of the scale of the attention logits, and we show that the product of two simplex-normalised weightings attenuates it by a factor 1/G. Removing these components changes nothing. Second, we build a point-in-time

translated_title: 状态门控注意力有助于股票收益预测吗？——一项控制数据泄露的预注册评估
translated_abstract: 状态感知注意力是股票收益预测中一种颇具吸引力的归纳偏置，但有关它的主张很少在控制数据泄露的样本外条件下得到检验。我们重新审视了自适应金融Transformer（AFT），该模型利用由市场状态编码器产生的门控所加权的特征组相似性来偏置自注意力机制。首先，在单一股票上采用修正后的协议（对齐并清洗的窗口、所有模型使用相同的测试日期、考虑成本的非重叠回测、五个随机种子、Diebold-Mariano检验），没有任何学习模型能够超越历史均值预测。AFT的状态与上下文组件在数值上是无效的：学习到的门控具有0.9982的最大熵，上下文偏置仅占注意力logits尺度的0.020，并且我们证明两个单纯形归一化加权的乘积会将其衰减一个1/G的因子。移除这些组件不会带来任何改变。其次，我们构建了一个时点（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过控制数据泄露、预注册的严格评估重新检验了自适应金融Transformer（AFT），发现状态门控注意力对股票收益预测并无实际帮助——没有任何学习模型能超越历史均值预测，且AFT的门控与上下文组件在数值上近乎无效，移除它们不产生任何影响。
en_tdlr: Through a leakage-controlled, pre-registered evaluation, this paper re-examines the Adaptive Financial Transformer (AFT) and finds that regime-gated attention does not help stock return prediction—no learned model beats the historical-mean forecast, and AFT's regime and context components are numerically inert, with their removal changing nothing.
